column3: Kuroneko Route · Kuroneko's Assistant 2
A few days have passed within the blink of an eye ever since I started my job as an assistant.
During that time, I've noticed all sorts of things.
Friends have more surprising sides than I initially thought.
Kuroneko's ability to concentrate is really good. How many hours can she draw continuously?
If it was me, it would definitely be impossible to concentrate like that... is what I used to think in the past...
I've been working together with Kuroneko, haven't I? I'm being inspired by her.
Kyousuke～, could you help me wash the dishes?
...Mom, I'm going to the usual place, you know?
Can't you help me just for a bit? It won't take more than five minutes.
If it doesn't take that long, you should do it yourself...
But, it seems like you have a lot of free time on your hands.
Tch, guess there's no other choice...
I should be a good son once in a while.
Just washing them will do, right?
Yeah, I'm counting on you.
All right, then I'll quickly get this over with.
Oh, you even wiped all the dishes? Thanks!
Hmm, well, if it's just this much...
Hmm-hmm, Mom is really happy that you've become this nice.
Uh... well, it's just this little bit...
There there. Then I'm counting on you next time as well.
Hey...!
However, well... if this little deed makes her this happy, I guess it's not that bad after all.
...I guess it's fine once in a while.
I see. Thank you, Kyousuke.
Come to think of it, haven't you been acting a little strange recently?
Guh... well, although I'm aware of that too...
However, I don't think it'll be good telling my own mother about it. It just feels a little embarrassing... or rather, I'll definitely be teased by her?
Mom and Dad are different, it'll certainly spread uncontrollably once I tell her, and I can't imagine the results...
Against one's mother, it's not like I'll give her material to tease me about.
I won't continue helping you if you keep trying to flatter me.
My my, I'm not doing such things.
It's about time anyway, I have to go already!
...Really. Okay okay, Take care. Say hi to your girlfriend for me～
Like I said, she's not my girlfriend...
It seems I have a really hardworking kouhai.
Uh huh.
I thought of helping her out. That's why I felt like I need to be hardworking too.
Hmm～
That was a rather lacking response...
So then, I was thinking "Since I have nothing to do, what can I do?".
Ah, is that right?
Why are you so surprised?
That's because I feel that Kyousuke is already doing 【the things that should be done】.
It seems that you've been rather happy recently, aren't you?  It looks like you're moving towards an goal.
I-Is that so?
It feels a little embarrassing when she puts it like that...
That child, I don't think she's just a kouhai to you, is she?
W-What are you saying all of a sudden...?
Don't underestimate your mother's eyes, okay? I can see through everything about you.
Guh... I-I'm running late! I'm going out!
Oh my, oh my, he ran away...
I did notice it a bit when I helped in the creation of that game last time... But this time, I was more involved in the process...? Compared to last time, I
could really feel it this time.
